## [▶ Open the slides](slides/index.html)

From no Python at all to a trained, evaluated classifier in two hours.
Nothing to install — everything runs in Google Colab.

This is the fast cut of the four-hour workshop: the same four steps
(Python → explore → first model → compare & challenge), without the
animations and with the explanations moved into the notebooks.
